newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-COFFEE TO DRIFT BUT THREATENS TO WEAKEN.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-COFFEE TO DRIFT BUT THREATENS TO WEAKEN.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Robusta coffee futures are expected to drift sideways for time being but prices are in danger of weakening unless an attempt is made soon to breach heavy resistance, analysts said on Tuesday.
London's nearby September contract has been content to meander in tight ranges for the past few sessions in mostly thin volume amid a lack of fresh fundamental news.

Although September has managed to recover from its nadir of $1,505, a low reached in mid-July, analysts said upward momentum was lacking and so unless a rally came soon the market was in danger of another slide.

"It has rallied a bit (since $1,505) but there's a lot of supply above the $1,700 level and I think it's going to have difficulty getting into that," said Susan Rigg, a technical analyst at Chart Analysis.
"I wouldn't be at all surprised if we saw a bit of a move on the downside towards $1,500. It's going to have to make $1,700, and probably $1,800, to say it's a false break," she said.
Traders called the London market to open broadly unchanged from Monday's close.
Other analysts have said prices also faced resistance in the form of the trading band between mid-June and mid-July, approximately from $1,700 to $1,900.
Short-term momentum indicators have been flat and around the neutral zero level for a number of sessions.
"It's looking a little bit unhappy and probably liable to drift," Rigg said.
